rows.commentary: 7.4: Dot ball from Lilly Mills to Lauren Kua.
7.5: Lilly Mills delivers, Lauren Kua goes for twenty-four with three fours, but a sharp throw from Chloe Piparo catches her short of her ground.
7.6: Lilly Mills targets Erin Burns, who tucks it away into the mid-wicket region to rotate the strike.
8.1: Ruby Strange steams in to Erin Burns, who drives a single out toward deep square leg.
8.2: Ruby Strange bowls to Lauren Cheatle, who guides the ball firmly towards sweeper cover for a brisk single.
8.3: Erin Burns does not score off Ruby Strange.
8.4: No run for Erin Burns off Ruby Strange.
8.5: No run for Erin Burns off Ruby Strange.
8.6: Ruby Strange serves it up to Erin Burns, who pushes it toward extra cover and scampers across for one.
9.1: Shay Manolini gets greeted by Erin Burns, who works the ball backward of square leg to comfortably pick up two runs.
9.2: Shay Manolini tests Erin Burns, who nudges it neatly into the mid-off region for a sharp single.
9.3: Lauren Cheatle does not score off Shay Manolini.
9.4: Shay Manolini fires one at Lauren Cheatle, who lofts it out to long-on to collect a comfortable run.
9.5: Shay Manolini delivers to Erin Burns, who dabs the ball towards cover to add another single to the total.
9.6: Shay Manolini pushes the final delivery to Lauren Cheatle, who drives it down to long-on for a single to close the over.
19.6: Amy Edgar loops it through, and Sarah Coyte sweeps the final delivery down to long-on to scamper through for a single.
0.1: Sippel charges in and Katie Mack immediately greets her with a vicious drive screaming away to the long-on boundary for four.
0.2: Sippel keeps it tight, forcing Katie Mack to flick this delivery into the mid-wicket pocket for a brisk single.
0.3: Ines McKeon does not score off Sippel.
0.4: Sippel fires it in, and Ines McKeon works it neatly across toward deep square leg to pick up one run.
0.5: Sippel attacks the stumps again, allowing Katie Mack to turn it out toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
0.6: Ines McKeon does not score off Sippel.
1.1: Frankie Nicklin drops short, and Katie Mack ruthlessly pulls it away into the deep mid-wicket turf for four.
1.2: Katie Mack does not score off Frankie Nicklin.
1.3: No run for Katie Mack off Frankie Nicklin.
1.4: Frankie Nicklin offers width, and Katie Mack punishes it with a gorgeous stroke through deep extra cover racing to the fence.
1.5: Frankie Nicklin strays again, and Katie Mack dispatches it with authority once more toward the deep mid-wicket boundary for four.
1.6: No run for Katie Mack off Frankie Nicklin.
2.1: Sippel pitches it up, and Ines McKeon carves it exquisitely past sweeper cover to find the boundary rope.
2.2: No run for Ines McKeon off Sippel.
2.3: Ines McKeon does not score off Sippel.
2.4: Sippel floats it through the air, and Ines McKeon lofts it powerfully down toward long-off for four runs.
16.1: Sarah Coyte delivers to Ruby Strange, turning it away into the deep mid-wicket pocket for a single.
16.2: Sarah Coyte targets the stumps, and Taneale Peschel nudges it down toward long-on to rotate the strike.
16.3: Sarah Coyte floats this one up, pushed deftly by Ruby Strange toward extra cover for a brisk single.
16.4: Dot ball from Sarah Coyte to Taneale Peschel.
16.5: Sarah Coyte keeps it tight as Taneale Peschel sweeps a single out toward the deep mid-wicket boundary fielder.
16.6: Sarah Coyte finishes the over as Ruby Strange collects a single out in the deep mid-wicket region.
17.1: Frankie Nicklin is greeted harshly, carved away by Ruby Strange through deep extra cover all the way to the rope for four.
17.2: Frankie Nicklin adjusts her length, allowing Ruby Strange to flick a quick single toward mid-wicket.
17.3: Frankie Nicklin serves one up that Taneale Peschel drives powerfully down to long-on, easily scampering back for a brace.
17.4: Frankie Nicklin is launched over the rope into long-on for a magnificent six by Taneale Peschel.
17.5: Frankie Nicklin bowls to Taneale Peschel, who works it smartly toward backward square leg for a single.
17.6: Ruby Strange does not score off Frankie Nicklin.
18.1: Sarah Coyte returns to the attack, with Taneale Peschel pushing a single out to deep mid-wicket.
18.2: Sarah Coyte pitches it up, allowing Ruby Strange to punch a single away toward deep extra cover.
18.3: Sarah Coyte delivers, and Taneale Peschel works the ball neatly away toward mid-wicket for a single.
18.4: Sarah Coyte charges in again, steering Ruby Strange down to long-on to collect one run.
18.5: Taneale Peschel does not score off Sarah Coyte.
18.6: Sarah Coyte completes the over as Taneale Peschel drives firmly into the deep extra cover region to race back for a well-judged couple.
19.1: Frankie Nicklin draws the false stroke from Ruby Strange, who chips it straight to Caoimhe Bray to depart for fourteen.
19.2: Frankie Nicklin steams in to Amy Edgar, who guides the delivery down to the third man boundary region, scampering back urgently to comfortably complete a sharp two runs.
19.3: Frankie Nicklin outsmarts Amy Edgar completely, leaving Hayley Zauch with the simplest of stumpings behind the stumps.
19.4: Lilly Mills finds the gap in the V, pushing Frankie Nicklin away into the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
19.5: Taneale Peschel works Frankie Nicklin firmly through the leg side, rotating the strike with a well-run single to deep mid-wicket.
19.6: Lilly Mills brings down the curtain on the over, nudging Frankie Nicklin neatly toward backward square leg for one final single.
